concept.title: Five-a-side football to meet people
concept.shortdesc: As a newcomer to a city, I need a five-a-side league or casual kickabout, so that I can play football and meet people.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-017). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Many leagues are in closed groups with no public listing.
A good result: Leagues and sessions that take individuals, with night, place and cost.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.
